Food for me as someone with #colitis and #ibs is a bit of a minefield. One wrong spoonful and I can spend days in serious agony. So my best recommendation for those who have similar conditions is to keep a food diary. This is the best way to identify what triggers your symptoms. For me eating foods that are wholewheat or high in fibre are a massive trigger. I avoid eating whole vegetables and fruits, instead I will have them in either a soup, a juice or a smoothie, as it is easier for my stoma to digest. #whatieatinaday #foodie #ibd #stoma

Things we are entitled too ❤️ my mum found this all out for me when I was diagnosed bless her. I’m not sure about other countries; I shared this on Instagram before & many people in other Countries sadly don’t get all these benefits but if you’re in the UK with IBD then please watch ❤️ I have a disabled bus pass which helps me a lot; go on your local council website & apply for one ❤️ I used to get money off the water bill, it is a life saver 💕 we can’t help how often we use the toilet & flush it 🙏 call up your water company & explain you have IBD & it’s a disability & ask to fill in the disability form to get money off 💕 Go on the Crohn’s website to order a radar key which unlocks any disabled toilet anywhere & a toilet card to let you show to anyone in shops ect so you can use the toilets anywhere ❤️ & possible disability benefits, depending on how serve your symptoms are but always worth trying ❤️ #IBD #ibd #ibdawareness #ibdwarrior #ibdahnya #ibdp #ibdiploma #crohns #crohnsdisease #crohnsawareness #crohnsandcolitis #crohnswarrior #crohnsdiseasecheck #crohnsandcolitisawarenessweek #crohnsdiseaseawareness #crohnswithme #ulcer #ulcerativecolitis #ulcerativecolitisproblems #ulcerativecolitisandcrohnsawareness #ulcerativecolitiswarrior #colitis #colitisawareness #microscopiccolitis #colitissurvivor #colitiswarrior #spoonie #spoonielife #spooniesoftiktok #spoonielife #spooniehumor #spoonietiktok #chronicillness #chronic #chronicpain #chronicillnessawareness #fy #fyp #viral

Things we are entitled too ❤️ my mum found this all out for me when I was diagnosed bless her. I’m not sure about other countries; I shared this on Instagram before & many people in other Countries sadly don’t get all these benefits but if you’re in the UK with IBD then please watch ❤️ I have a disabled bus pass which helps me a lot; go on your local council website & apply for one ❤️ I used to get money off the water bill, it is a life saver 💕 we can’t help how often we use the toilet & flush it 🙏 call up your water company & explain you have IBD & it’s a disability & ask to fill in the disability form to get money off 💕 Go on the Crohn’s website to order a radar key which unlocks any disabled toilet anywhere & a toilet card to let you show to anyone in shops ect so you can use the toilets anywhere ❤️ & possible disability benefits, depending on how serve your symptoms are but always worth trying ❤️ #IBD #ibd #ibdawareness #ibdwarrior #ibdahnya #ibdp #ibdiploma #crohns #crohnsdisease #crohnsawareness #crohnsandcolitis #crohnswarrior #crohnsdiseasecheck #crohnsandcolitisawarenessweek #crohnsdiseaseawareness #crohnswithme #ulcer #ulcerativecolitis #ulcerativecolitisproblems #ulcerativecolitisandcrohnsawareness #ulcerativecolitiswarrior #colitis #colitisawareness #microscopiccolitis #colitissurvivor #colitiswarrior #spoonie #spoonielife #spooniesoftiktok #spoonielife #spooniehumor #spoonietiktok #chronicillness #chronic #chronicpain #chronicillnessawareness #fy #fyp #viral

LETS CHAT - Colitis, IBS And Crohns. I’ve had a few chats recently with worried sufferers. Having tried for years with other coaches who don’t understand what comes with having any of the above. YES ITS SH*T 🙈 but it doesn’t prevent you from achieving the lifestyle you wish to live. Infact quite the opposite. I myself was diagnosed at 20 with Ulcerative Colitis.  My lifestyle  as a youngster caused regular inflammation of my gut. Anyone with any of these will contest to the discomfort that comes with that 🙈  Naturally I thought I was dying ( thanks for the inheritance  of anxiety Mum) Over the years I’ve learned how to deal with it. What it needs and when.  And what to avoid!!!! 😉 I haven’t let it rule my life as some people do. It is not an issue I’ve ever really spoken about, as it doesn’t hold that much significance in my day to day as I know my body.  It sure as f*ck hasn’t messed with my ability to train.  I love my food ( as most of you know ) so I actually utilised having to eat more 🥳 That’s turning a frown upside down 😂 Do you suffer from any of these? #colitis #ibs #crohns

If you’re suffering from loose stools or diarrhea...This is why 💩 We all know our body’s creates diarrhea or vomiting when we have got an infection or a bug 🦠  So these symptoms occur when your body is trying to flush out the bug 🐛  That’s where the loose stool comes from…🤯 If you've got diarrhoea and loose stools all the time that means that youve got an infection that your body cannot get out 🧐 Its constantly trying to flush it out, however, it cannot resolve it, hence the recurring diarrhoea 👎 So the reason why you have got loose stools is because you've got either (or a combination of: -Bacterial overgrowths🦠  -fungal overgrowths 🍄  -Viral infections🦠  -parasitic infections 🐛  Which are knocking your body out of balance and creating the loose stools 🚽  The good news is you can cleanse them all out in one go ✨ And you no longer suffer with loose stools and other not so lovely feelings that come with it ✅ . . . . . . . #diarrhea #loosestools #health #guthealth #ibs #ibd #colitis #uc #ulcerativecolitis #crohns #crohnsdisease #qenda

LETS CHAT - Colitis, IBS And Crohns. I’ve had a few chats recently with worried sufferers. Having tried for years with other coaches who don’t understand what comes with having any of the above. YES ITS SH*T 🙈 but it doesn’t prevent you from achieving the lifestyle you wish to live. Infact quite the opposite. I myself was diagnosed at 20 with Ulcerative Colitis.  My lifestyle  as a youngster caused regular inflammation of my gut. Anyone with any of these will contest to the discomfort that comes with that 🙈  Naturally I thought I was dying ( thanks for the inheritance  of anxiety Mum) Over the years I’ve learned how to deal with it. What it needs and when.  And what to avoid!!!! 😉 I haven’t let it rule my life as some people do. It is not an issue I’ve ever really spoken about, as it doesn’t hold that much significance in my day to day as I know my body.  It sure as f*ck hasn’t messed with my ability to train.  I love my food ( as most of you know ) so I actually utilised having to eat more 🥳 That’s turning a frown upside down 😂 Do you suffer from any of these? #colitis #ibs #crohns

When you have food intolerance…🥴 Simply cutting out the food that you're intolerant to is not gonna fix anything… Let me explain: 🤓 Once you're eating the food, it goes from your stomach to your small intestines... The role of the small intestines is to only let through digested broken down food 🍗  When your intestines get inflamed, your intestinal lining can let through undigested food particles in your blood This creates an immune response 😱 Your immune system perceives the undigested food as an intruder 🦠  It thinks it’s trying to attack your body, like a virus so it creates that inflammation 🔫  By simply cutting out the problem food...you’re not dealing with the root cause… The best way to deal with these food intolerances is to fix your intestinal lining ✨ Fixing your intestinal lining combined with cutting out the foods for 3-6 months…✅ Now you can reintroduce the foods you was previously intolerant to and get your freedom back💚 . . . . . . . #gutheal#guthealtht#foodintolerancet#foodintolerancesb#ibsr#ibd #crohnsd#crohnsdiseases#colitisc#uct#ulcerativecolitisiculitis

Healthy balanced meal for the whole family. 😋 Even my fussy kids had second round and it’s a great way to hide the veggies 😉 - that’s also true if you are an adult who struggle to eat veggies (I get these comments quite often lately 👀 - be an adult and eat your vegetables)  Also great for meal prep. 👌 4 servings 421 kcals 11g fat 49.4 carbs (15.5g fibre) 35.2 protein Ingredients: 400g chicken breast 1 red bell pepper 1 leek 2 tbs olive oil 300ml chicken stock 160g cous cous (dry) A bunch of spinach  1 tsp parsley 1tsp paprika powder 1 tsp cumin Salt Pepper 1. Chop the pepper, leek and dice the chicken and place them in a pot or wok. 2. Add the seasonings and cook until chicken is cooked. 3. Add chicken stock and couscous. 4. Boil for a few mins till the cous cous is soaked then add spinach. 4. Close the hob and cover for 10 mins. You can top it with cheese and fresh herbs if you like. Vegan option: swap chicken with tofu. Also you can add/swap veggies for your liking, there is no set rules what you put in it. If you're getting acid reflux, heartburn or indigestion…😩 It is because you are drinking after your meals! 💧  The best way to support your digestion is to not drink water after your meals 🤓 Ideally, you would hydrate yourself between meals, so water up to 15 minutes before a meal. Then eat your food… 🥘  Then wait 1.5 hours before you have anything to drink afterwards ✅ The reason for that is once you’ve eaten your food… It goes into your stomach and it stays in your stomach for 1.5 hours And if you’ve  had a high fat meal it stays in your stomach for 2 hours before moving into your small intestine ⏳ So you want to be waiting at least an hour and a half to two hours after meals before you have another drink 💦  If you drink within that 1.5 to 2 hour window… ...You’re actually watering down digestive enzymes then your stomach has to compensate with the stomach acid  And that extra stomach acid is why you’re getting acid reflux / heartburn / indigestion 💡 The way to fix these symptoms is stop drinking after your meals 🤚 Set a timer on your phone and don't drink anything at least an hour & a half to two hours ⏰  I can guarantee it will fix your acid reflux! 🤓 If it doesn’t, you’re the very small percent of people that has parasitic infections in your stomach and you need to cleanse it out 🐛  . . . . . . . . #acidref#acidrefluxs#indigestionl#guthealthu#heartburnb#ibsr#ibd #colitis

If you’re having blood in your bowel movements🩸  It actually tells us a lot about what’s going on inside your body 🤓 The colour of the blood in your stools can tell us where it’s coming from in your body💡  If you’ve got green blood in your stools, that shows that it’s coming from your small intestine The small intestine has released the blood and then tried to digest it ...by the time it comes out in your stool, it actually turns green 🐸 If you've got fresh red blood, that can mean one of two things: 1 when it’s fresh red blood or clots coming out WITH your stool AS you're having a bowel movement… 🩸  ...it's very likely that it’s your large intestines has ulcerations 2 If you're getting blood just at the end of a bowel movement and  when you’re wiping that’s likely haemorrhoids 🚽  So it can tell us a lot of what’s going on in your body just from the colour of the blood…👌 P.s The way to deal with haemorrhoids - not to push and use a toilet stool for mimicking the natural squat position 🏋️‍♂️  . . . . . . . #cro#crohnsl#colitisd#ibds#ibso#crohnsdiseaseo#crohnsandcolitiso#crohnsandcolitisukc#ulcerativecolitist#guthealtht

4 foods that help your body combat stress ⬇️ ⁠ ⁠ 🫐 BLUEBERRIES ⁠ Blueberries contain antioxidants called proanthocyanidins. 4 ways to help stabilise your blood sugar 👉🏼 and naturally enhance your energy levels 🚀 
 1️⃣ Include protein + healthy fats at every meal and snack. The combination of these will help stabilise blood sugar and encourage sustained energy levels.  2️⃣ Swap simple carbs for complex carbs – choose wholegrains, oats, buckwheat, quinoa and lentils over white bread, white pasta, cakes and biscuits. Complex carbs lead to the energy being released more gradually into the bloodstream. 3️⃣ Eat more fibre (aim for 30g/day). Because the body is unable to absorb and break down fibre, it doesn’t cause a spike in blood sugar the way other carbohydrates can. 
 4️⃣ Avoid heavy meals, especially at lunch and dinner – studies have shown those who eat a big lunch typically experience a more dramatic afternoon slump, as a result of the blood sugar rollercoaster, while a heavy dinner can interfere with your sleep.

If you're having issues absorbing the nutrients from your food 🤔 It's very likely that you've got inflammation in your intestines creating this issue 👎 Thees villi increase the surface area of you the intestines because they are finger-like projections 🖐  Your villi help you absorb more nutrients ✅ Even though you might be having the most nutrient-dense diet and you put in all the calories and you're still not gaining weight 🤷‍♂️ Its probably cause you have damaged villi 😱 Once your intestines have been inflamed over a period of time⏳ ...You can damage the villi which are like finger-like projections that are lining the whole of your intestinal tract 🤕 This is where these villi litterally disappear from the damage so your intestines are left with a flat inflamed intestinal lining...☹️ So you have to deal with the factors that are creating the inflammation/damage 💪🏻 ...and that's always because of some type of overgrowths - fungal 🍄, bacterial 🦠, viral ☠️ parasites 🐛  You need to cleanse out these overgrowths and give your body the nutrients and then you can get your villi back and absorb nutrients in your food again 🤩 . . . . . . . #crohns #colitis #ibd #ibs #crohnsdisease #crohnsandcolitis #crohnsandcolitisuk #ulcerativecolitis #guthealth #gut #guthealth #qenda #knowledgeispower #bloating #sibo #mouldinfection #toenailfungus

Do you have low iron or are having iron tablets all the time? 🤷‍♂️ Firstly, have you seen the ingredients list on your prescription iron tablets? 🤭 You think they will just be iron. The tablets are generally called ferrous sulphate which is iron and sulphur combined 🌋  However, there is more than just a bulking agent that makes up the rest of the tablet 💊  Some of the other ingredients include talc, sugar and titanium dioxide (E171) in there! 😱 titanium dioxide (E171) has been banned in all EU countries, but it is still allowed in the iron tablets here 🤷‍♂️ Titanium dioxide has been banned because it is a nanoparticle (very small) metal that can pass through your blood and into your vital organs 👎 The main reason why people an iron deficiency, in my opinion, is because they have either a parasitic infection or a bacterial overgrowth 🐛  And these infections and overgrowths eat your iron and eat your B12 whilst dumping isopropyl alcohol, lactic acid, and phenol into your body! 🦠  Even if you have the most alkaline diet in the world, having these parasitic infections or a bacterial overgrowths in you can make your body very acidic 🧪  . . . . . . . #crohns #colonicmassage #colitis #ibd #ibs #crohnsdisease #crohnsandcolitis #crohnsandcolitisuk #ulcerativecolitis #guthealth #gut #guthealth #qenda #knowledgeispower #bloating #sibo #mouldinfection #toenailfungus #autoimmune #digestiveexpert #leakygut #anemia #anemic #anemicproblems

When my son was a child he was diagnosed with colitis and we were eligible for a blue badge due to his needs (rushing to the toilet or cleaning him up after an accident)  Blue Badges are done by your local council not the government or benefits department. The eligibility is as follows; High Rate DLA or PIP ✔️ Over 10 points for not being able to plan & follow a journey due to Psychological distress ✔️  Blindness or Eye Issues ✔️ However, if you don’t get 10 points please don’t be put off, they will accept an application with proof of eligibility  And if you are still being turned down you can appeal or take it to the ombudsman. If you’re not having 3 bowel movements a day, you could get very ill  If you’re having 3 meals a day, and then you're not having 3 bowel movements a day that shows that your outputs are not matching your inputs When you digest food, your food goes down to your stomach, then further gets broken down in your small intestine  Then the what's left over gets passed down into your large intestine ready to go into the toilet 🚽  It is not just food waste that your body needs to excrete though... Your whole lymphatic system excretes waste into your blood… Then your liver and kidneys are there to clean the waste out of your blood  This is also dumped into your intestines for excretion. So it’s not just food coming out… It's actually the majority of the waste from your body that has to come out So if you're having three meals a day and only having one or even less bowel movements a day You will ultimately have a lot of waste backing up and getting re-absorbed into your blood which can create a lot of issues like: -brain fog  -achy joints and muscles -fatigue -fibromyalgia -bloating -parasitic infections etc DM me if you would like to know more 💚 . . . . . . . #cro#crohnsl#colonicmassagel#colitisd#ibds#ibso#crohnsdiseaseo#crohnsandcolitiso#crohnsandcolitisukc#ulcerativecolitist#guthealtht#gutt#guthealthn#qendao#knowledgeispowero#bloatingb#sibou#mouldinfectione#toenailfungust#autoimmuneg#digestiveexperta#leakygutx#anxietyp#depressionn#mentalhealthn#constipationcrobiome

Taping your mouth before you go to sleep is the best thing you can do to improve your sleep 🏆  When we go to sleep, we can sleep with our mouth open and we can start breathing through our mouth 😵 When you breathe through your mouth creates stress in your body, as you can only ever have shallower breaths this way 🌬  When you breathe through your nose, it calms the body down because you're using the lower part of your lungs 👃  But more importantly, when you’re a mouth breather when you sleep... Lets say your head’s back on the pillow, your tongue can roll back in your mouth and semi-wake you up 😢 Meaning that you never properly get into your restorative deep sleep cycles 👎 After my motocross accident and all the subsequent operations, I was getting zero minutes of deep sleep in a night 😳 I waking up tired 😓  What I found the best thing to do was to tape my mouth up before bed 🛌  What I do -  I get a strip of micropore tape, cut about 2 inches, pinch my lips, and put the the tape over them 👄  If you wake up at night and need a drink, you can always peel it down and have a drink, then put it back in position ✅ Of all the things I did to improve my sleep… 🛏  Mouth taping is my number 1 best tip I can to improve your sleep 🥰 DM to book a free 15 minute 1-1 coaching call 💚 . . . . . . . #c#crohnsc#colonicmassagec#colitisi#ibdi#ibsc#crohnsdiseasec#crohnsandcolitisc#crohnsandcolitisuku#ulcerativecolitisg#guthealthg#gutg#guthealthq#qendak#knowledgeispowerb#bloatings#sibom#mouldinfectiont#toenailfungusa#autoimmuned#digestiveexpertl#leakyguta#anxietyd#depressionm#mentalhealthc#constipationmicrobiome

What causes your IBS? & How to fix it in 60 seconds ⏳  IBS is caused by an infection or an imbalance in your small intestine … Then when the carbohydrates you eat go into your small intestine and ferment with these overgrowths and imbalances 😳 This creates inflammation, gas and bloating 💨  When you have these imbalances in your small intestine, it creates inflammation inside the intestinal lining 🔥  Instead of your intestinal cells being tight junctions together, you get gaps between them 🕳️ When your undigested food passes through these gaps in your inflamed intestines, it goes straight into your blood 🩸  Then your immune system perceives the undigested food as an intruder and then makes antibodies against that food 👾 You then have a food intolerance👎 When you consume that food again, you end up with a reaction and more inflammation😫 So then you end up with diarrhoea and/or constipation 🌧️  Also, this immune response and inflammation in the blood can end up making you have lethargy, low mood and brain fog 🫠 The way to fix all these IBS symptoms is to remove the infections and imbalances from your small intestines ✅ DM me and I’ll be happy to explain more 💚 . . . . . . . #c#crohnsc#colonicmassagec#colitisi#ibdi#ibsc#crohnsdiseasec#crohnsandcolitisc#crohnsandcolitisuku#ulcerativecolitisg#guthealthg#gutg#guthealthq#qendak#knowledgeispowerb#bloatings#sibom#mouldinfectiont#toenailfungusa#autoimmuned#digestiveexpertl#leakyguta#anxietyd#depressionm#mentalhealthc#constipationm#microbiomel#leakygutp#probioticfoodintolerance

If you've got blood in the toilet after a bowel movement 🩸🚽  It can tell us so much about what's going on in your body ✅ If it's green blood and really smelly: That tends to come from higher up in your digestive system - from your small intestine ⬆️  The reason why its green cause your small intestine tried digesting it🙈 And that’s what makes it green cause its mixed with the bile 🐸 If you have blood clots in your stool or fresh red blood 🩸  That generally comes from the large intestines … The reason why it's more fresh when it comes from the large intestine cause this is the last part of your digestive system 💡  This is normally from ulcerations in your large intestines 🩸💩  And it can also be from haemorrhoids if you're pushing too much whilst you're having a bowel movement. This usually follows your stool. 💩 🩸  And then lastly, if you've got blood after you've wiped and its on the tissue, it’s likely haemorrhoids as well 🤓 …Or it could be a sore from too many bowel movements and from wiping 🧻  Feel free to DM me if you have blood in your stools and you want to know more 💚 . . . . . . . #cro#crohnsl#colonicmassagel#colitisd#ibds#ibso#crohnsdiseaseo#crohnsandcolitiso#crohnsandcolitisukc#ulcerativecolitist#guthealtht#gutt#guthealthn#qendao#knowledgeispowero#bloatingb#sibou#mouldinfectione#toenailfungust#autoimmuneg#digestiveexperta#leakygutx#anxietyp#depressionn#mentalhealthn#constipationc#microbiomea#leakyguto#probioticodintolerance

Two things you can do to fix your acid reflux, GERD, and hiatus hernia ✅ 1- fast after your meals: When you eat your meal, your food goes down to your stomach  … Then your stomach releases enzymes to breakdown the food 🔁 If you're drinking liquids less than 1.5 hours after a meal whilst the food is still in your stomach 🥘 You are actually watering down those beneficial enzymes, so your stomach has to compensate with stomach acid🫢 That's where I believe you can get the acid reflux, GERD & the Hiatius hernia from 💡 Then if you're getting your symptoms when you go to bed: 2- make sure you're not eating any food more than 2 hours before you go to bed 👌 Combine 1 + 2 together  …✨ If your symptoms still persists, you've either got an infection or overgrowth in your small intestine 🦠 DM me if you want to know more 💚 . . . . . . . #cro#crohnsl#colonicmassagel#colitisd#ibds#ibso#crohnsdiseaseo#crohnsandcolitiso#crohnsandcolitisukc#ulcerativecolitist#guthealtht#gutt#guthealthn#qendao#knowledgeispowero#bloatingb#sibou#mouldinfectione#toenailfungust#autoimmuneg#digestiveexperta#leakygutx#anxietyp#depressionn#mentalhealthn#constipationc#microbiomea#leakyguto#probiotico#foodintoleranceo#psoriasise#creamz#eczematuralremedy

The best diet for healing would be one that would removes the inflammatory foods ✅ There’s 3 main food groups that you can get rid off: First one would be gluten 🍞  Gluten is known to cause your small intestine release zonulin… And create a leaky ‘compromised’ gut lining and spread inflammation all around your body 😱 Secondly, you want to be removing sugar out your diet 🍬  Simply put, sugar stresses your body😳 Sugar creates a cortisol response (stress hormone which lowers your immune system) The third dietary change is you want to get rid of the hydrogenated vegetable oils 🍟 These hydrogenated vegetable oils are known to create inflammation in the body.🤯 They are high in omega 6 and they’ve been raised to high temperatures that they’ve been overcooked so they become a carcinogenic “cancer-causing agent”😩 Cut out the vegetable oil, sugar, gluten and you will do yourself a big favour ✅ Cutting out these foods will help take away some daily dietary damage done to your body However, when people have chronic digestive isssues, just changing your diet alone is not going to cut it! We must deal with the big elephant in the room 🐘  The actual root causes are overgrowths and infections creating the leaky gut 🧐 Leaky gut means inflammation anle to spread everywhere in your body You need to cleanse your body get rid of these overgrowths 🐛  Heal & seal the gut lining 🤝  And reverse your symptoms ✨ . . . . . . . #g#guthealthc#crohnsc#colitisu#ucc#crohnsdiseaset#tysonm#miketysonc#crohnsandcolitisc#crohnsandcolitisuki#ibdi#ibssugarfree

PEANUT BUTTER BANANA CARAMEL SQUARES 🥜🍌⁠ ⁠ INGREDIENTS 👉🏼⁠ ⁠ BASE LAYER:⁠ ✔️2/3 cup oats⁠  ✔️1/4 cup cashews⁠ ✔️1/2 cup medjool dates, pitted⁠ ✔️1/4 tsp sea salt⁠ ⁠ CARAMEL LAYER:⁠ ✔️2 bananas⁠ ✔️1/2 cup runny peanut butter⁠ @ManiLife Peanut Butter  ✔️1/3 cup coconut sugar⁠ ✔️1/2 cup coconut oil, melted⁠ ✔️2 tbsp maca powder @KoRo ⁠ ✔️1/4 tsp sea salt⁠ ⁠ CHOCOLATE LAYER:⁠ ✔️3/4 cup (100g) dark chocolate, broken into chunks⁠ @ombarchocolate  ✔️1 tbsp coconut oil⁠ ✔️Optional: dried rose petals⁠ ⁠ METHOD 👉🏼⁠ Soak the dates in boiling water for 10 minutes.⁠ Meanwhile, add the oats, nuts and salt to a food processor and pulse until a flour is formed. ⁠ Drain the dates and add to the oat-nut mix and blend until a cookie dough-like consistency is formed.⁠ Line a small square brownie tin with parchment paper and press the mixture down to form an even layer. Place in the fridge.⁠ ⁠ To make the caramel layer, add one banana, peanut butter, sweetener, coconut oil and salt to the food processor and blend until smooth. ⁠ Slice the other banana into rounds. ⁠ Pour the caramel over the base and place the banana slices on top, pressing them down slightly. Place in the fridge to set (around 45 minutes).⁠ ⁠ To make the chocolate layer, melt together the chocolate and coconut oil and pour this evenly over the caramel layer (when set). ⁠ Sprinkle with rose petals if using and return to the fridge for at least one hour, until completely set.⁠ ⁠ When set, lift the parchment paper up to remove the bars from the brownie tin and slice into squares. ⁠Serve and enjoy! ⁠ ⁠ Store on the fridge for up to 5 days or freeze for up to 1 month.⁠ ⁠ ⁠ ⁠www.elibrecher.co.uk/peanut-butter-banana-squares/⁠ .⁠ .⁠ #elibrechernutrition #peanutbuttercaramelsquares #veganrecipes #veganpeanutbuttersquares #guthealth #nutritionist #nutritionistlondon #digestivehealth #gut #guthealthy #gutmicrobiome #microbiome #gutbrainaxis #crohns #colitis #ibd #ibs #inflammation #probiotics #dairyfree #glutenfree #autoimmune #healthyrecipes #guthealthnutritionist

Two things you can do to fix your acid reflux, GERD, and hiatus hernia ✅ 1- fast after your meals: When you eat your meal, your food goes down to your stomach  … Then your stomach releases enzymes to breakdown the food 🔁 If you're drinking liquids less than 1.5 hours after a meal whilst the food is still in your stomach 🥘 You are actually watering down those beneficial enzymes, so your stomach has to compensate with stomach acid🫢 That's where I believe you can get the acid reflux, GERD & the Hiatius hernia from 💡 Then if you're getting your symptoms when you go to bed: 2- make sure you're not eating any food more than 2 hours before you go to bed 👌 Combine 1 + 2 together  …✨ If your symptoms still persists, you've either got an infection or overgrowth in your small intestine 🦠 DM me if you want to know more 💚 . . . . . . . #cro#crohnsl#colonicmassagel#colitisd#ibds#ibso#crohnsdiseaseo#crohnsandcolitiso#crohnsandcolitisukc#ulcerativecolitist#guthealtht#gutt#guthealthn#qendao#knowledgeispowero#bloatingb#sibou#mouldinfectione#toenailfungust#autoimmuneg#digestiveexperta#leakygutx#anxietyp#depressionn#mentalhealthn#constipationc#microbiomea#leakyguto#probiotico#foodintoleranceo#psoriasise#creamz#eczematuralremedy

WHY ARE GUT MICROBES IMPORTANT? ⁠ ⁠ Gut microbes:⁠ ✅ Make nutrients⁠ ✅ Make neurotransmitters (messengers in your nervous system, similar to hormones)⁠ ✅ Are part of the immune function⁠ ✅ Control where waste goes ⁠ ✅ Make vital short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) which are involved with immunity, keeping the gut healthy, moderating the body’s inflammatory responses and the metabolism of glucose.⁠ ⁠ We need to look after our gut microbes by ensuring we get adequate fibre (aim for 30g per day) and eat a diverse range of colourful fruit, veg, whole grains, beans and pulses each week 🥦🌟⁠ ⁠ Having personally experienced the stigma around talking about digestive health, I realised I had a true desire to help others suffering with similar health problems which can feel incredibly isolating, and to get the conversation going about gut health ⁠👉🏼⁠ ⁠ ⁠📞 Interested in working together to improve your gut health? Blondie-Brownie Bites 😍  INGREDIENTS 👇🏼 For the brownie layer: ✔️1 cup / 120g gluten free oat flour ✔️2/3 cup / 80g ground almonds  ✔️2/3 cup / 80g cacao powder  ✔️1 cup / 250ml almond milk ✔️1/4 cup / 65g melted coconut oil ✔️½ cup 120ml maple syrup ✔️1/3 cup / 50g chocolate chips/dark chocolate  ✔️2 tbsp sugar/ sweetener  ✔️1 tsp vanilla extract ✔️Pinch of sea salt For the blondie layer: ✔️1 cup / 120g gluten free oat flour ✔️2/3 cup / 80g ground almonds ✔️1/3 cup / 50g chocolate chips/dark chocolate ✔️1/3 cup / 90g smooth peanut butter @ManiLife Peanut Butter  ✔️1/4 cup / 60ml maple syrup ✔️1 tsp vanilla extract ✔️Pinch of sea salt METHOD 👇🏼  * Preheat the oven to 160C and line a square brownie tin with baking paper. * For the brownie layer, combine the oat flour, ground almonds, cacao, salt and sweetener in a bowl. * Add the remaining wet brownie ingredients and mix thoroughly. * Transfer the mixture into the lined tin and bake for 20 minutes. * Leave the brownies to cool in the tin before making the blondie layer. * To make the blondie layer, mix together all the ingredients until combined. * Press the blondie layer on top of the brownie layer, using the back of a wooden spoon to press down evenly. * Place in the fridge for 1 hour to set before slicing into squares. Enjoy! 2 years ago my world turned upside down After 6 years of remission I fall back. I was one of the many. But they never tell you why. It just happens. Since learning more about IBD and how it manifests I ticked of these boxes Stress - being self employed in the middle of pandemic wasn’t something that makes people relax. This has been topped with a bit of postpartum depression and a unfulfilled personal relationship. I didn’t pay attention to the mind- gut connection at all. Processed foods - eating healthy has been always my priority but I struggled to stay on track in my new relationship and then when looking after the baby. Habits got looser and looser. Exercise routine - home workouts just wasn’t the real thing to me during lockdown Sleep - having a newborn can make you sleep deprived  Everything lead up to my flare and I didn’t know how to control it. No one told me that a sympathetic nervous system cannot be overlooked. I got medications but my bowel still perforated.  I lost all my progress, and it was a huge trauma for me. At this time I was a single mother. I knew I had to take control again. I knew I had missed something at the first time so I decided to learn more and reflect on it. I was eating healthy and exercise. And I flared up again. I overlooked the importance of mental health and how is my mind connected to the gut. I didn’t pay attention that how much my processed food intake have increased.  I picked up bad habits. Step by step I’ve transformed my lifestyle again along with my strength. I was 55kg and malnourished when I came out of the hospital. I am now a 75kg healthy and strong woman. Strongest I’ve ever been and I was told to forget about lifting weights again. I was devastated. What did I do? I decided to be proactive and the my absolute best. I worked on myself. I went to physiotherapist. I made better food choices. I learnt healthy habits again. All I can say it was worth it. Your doctor may have recommended to go on low residue diet if: 👉 you have acute abdominal pain, diarrhoea, cramping, 👉 you have strictures 👉 you preparing for colonoscopy  👉 you are recovering from a recent bowel surgery The aim is to reduce the bowel movements and reduce the painful symptoms. The low residue diet limits fibre intake 10-15g per day however this is suggested to increase gradually 5g weekly until you hit the fibre goal - which is normally 20-25g. If you have strictures, you still can have fibre but you need to be vary of what types of fibre you can eat. The diet won’t decrease inflammation and won’t improve the underlying cause of your IBD. “In fact Swann and colleagues recently reported that a high-fiber diet might help reduce inflammation by altering the pH and permeability of the gut. Clinical trials on the anti-inflammatory effect of a high fiber diet have also shown promising results in patients with IBD.”  (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC9220141/) Several other studies suggest the dietary fibre can also help to maintain remission, supports gut health, protects from pathogens, improve the gut microbiome and immune response. In summary, only use low residue and low fibre diet only temporary and try to reintroduce fibre in your diet. Not sure how to start? Drop me a DM and I’ll help. Blondie-Brownie Bites 😍  INGREDIENTS 👇🏼 For the brownie layer: ✔️1 cup / 120g gluten free oat flour ✔️2/3 cup / 80g ground almonds  ✔️2/3 cup / 80g cacao powder  ✔️1 cup / 250ml almond milk ✔️1/4 cup / 65g melted coconut oil ✔️½ cup 120ml maple syrup ✔️1/3 cup / 50g chocolate chips/dark chocolate  ✔️2 tbsp sugar/ sweetener  ✔️1 tsp vanilla extract ✔️Pinch of sea salt For the blondie layer: ✔️1 cup / 120g gluten free oat flour ✔️2/3 cup / 80g ground almonds ✔️1/3 cup / 50g chocolate chips/dark chocolate ✔️1/3 cup / 90g smooth peanut butter @ManiLife Peanut Butter  ✔️1/4 cup / 60ml maple syrup ✔️1 tsp vanilla extract ✔️Pinch of sea salt METHOD 👇🏼  * Preheat the oven to 160C and line a square brownie tin with baking paper. * For the brownie layer, combine the oat flour, ground almonds, cacao, salt and sweetener in a bowl. * Add the remaining wet brownie ingredients and mix thoroughly. * Transfer the mixture into the lined tin and bake for 20 minutes. * Leave the brownies to cool in the tin before making the blondie layer. * To make the blondie layer, mix together all the ingredients until combined. * Press the blondie layer on top of the brownie layer, using the back of a wooden spoon to press down evenly. * Place in the fridge for 1 hour to set before slicing into squares. 4 foods that help your body combat stress ⬇️ ⁠ ⁠ 🫐 BLUEBERRIES ⁠ Blueberries contain antioxidants called proanthocyanidins. These protect our cells, especially brain cells 🧠 Blueberries are also great for our gut microbiome (the trillions of bacteria in our guts!) as they have a prebiotic effect (feed the good bacteria), which is key for creating calming neurotransmitters.⁠ ⁠ 🎃 PUMPKIN SEEDS ⁠ Pumpkin seeds are a great source of magnesium, which is required to regulate our stress response. They are rich in potassium, zinc and B vitamins - important for a healthy nervous system. They also contain the amino acid tryptophan (needed for the body to create serotonin, the "happy hormone").⁠ ⁠ 🥬 SPINACH ⁠ Dark leafy greens (like spinach, kale, chard) are rich in folate (needed to produce serotonin and dopamine) and are a great source of magnesium too.⁠ ⁠ 🐟 SALMON⁠ Salmon, as well as other oily fish (mackerel, anchovies and sardines), is rich in omega-3 fatty acids. These are essential for our brain health and are not produced by the body so must be consumed in the diet! ⁠ ⁠ ⁠ ⁠ ⁠📞 Interested in working together to improve your gut health? 4 ways to help stabilise your blood sugar 👉🏼 and naturally enhance your energy levels 🚀 
 1️⃣ Include protein + healthy fats at every meal and snack. The combination of these will help stabilise blood sugar and encourage sustained energy levels.  2️⃣ Swap simple carbs for complex carbs – choose wholegrains, oats, buckwheat, quinoa and lentils over white bread, white pasta, cakes and biscuits. Complex carbs lead to the energy being released more gradually into the bloodstream. 3️⃣ Eat more fibre (aim for 30g/day). Because the body is unable to absorb and break down fibre, it doesn’t cause a spike in blood sugar the way other carbohydrates can. 
 4️⃣ Avoid heavy meals, especially at lunch and dinner – studies have shown those who eat a big lunch typically experience a more dramatic afternoon slump, as a result of the blood sugar rollercoaster, while a heavy dinner can interfere with your sleep.

MINCE PIE PORRIDGE 🥣😍 ⁠ ⁠ INGREDIENTS 👇 ⁠ ⁠ For the mincemeat - Makes about 1 cup – use extras over a few days to top porridge/yoghurt/granola/pancakes⁠ ⁠ ✔️ ½ cup chopped apples (58g)⁠ ✔️ 4 tbsp raisins/sultanas (37g)⁠ ✔️ 2 tbsp dried cranberries⁠ ✔️ 2 tbsp chopped dates⁠ ✔️ 2 tbsp orange zest⁠ ✔️ ½ tsp ground cinnamon⁠ ✔️ ½ tsp ground ginger⁠ ✔️ ¼ tsp ground nutmeg⁠ ✔️ ¼ tsp ground cloves⁠ ✔️ 1 whole star anise⁠ ✔️ ¼ cup fresh orange juice⁠ ⁠ For the Porridge (Serves 1)⁠ ✔️ ½ cup (50g) rolled oats ⁠ ✔️ 1 tsp chia seeds⁠ ✔️ ½ cup (125ml) almond milk ⁠ ✔️ ½ cup (125ml) water ⁠ ✔️ 1 tsp ground cinnamon⁠ ✔️ ½ tsp ground ginger⁠ ✔️ 1 tsp orange zest⁠ ✔️ Optional: 1 tsp date syrup/maple syrup⁠ ⁠ Toppings: ⁠ ✔️ 2 tbsp plain yoghurt (can use dairy-free)⁠ ✔️ 2 tbsp chopped pecans⁠ ✔️ ½ tsp grated orange zest⁠ ⁠ Method 👇 ⁠ ⁠ 1️⃣ To make the mincemeat, chop the apples into small cubes (leave the skin on) and add to a pan with all other mincemeat ingredients.⁠ 2️⃣ Stir well, then cover with a lid and leave to simmer for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally. You can add a splash of water if it looks like all the liquid has absorbed before it’s finished cooking. Remove from the heat and allow to cool while you make your porridge.⁠ 3️⃣ Add the oats and chia seeds to a pan, pour over the water and milk and turn the heat to medium. Stir in the cinnamon, ginger and orange zest and cook for 5 minutes, stirring regularly. Then reduce the heat to low and continue cooking for a further 2 minutes, or until your desired consistency is reached. Stir in 2 tbsp mincemeat, along with your maple/date syrup if using. ⁠ 4️⃣ Transfer to a bowl and add a dollop of yoghurt on top, followed by 2 tbsp of the mincemeat, a sprinkle of chopped nuts and an extra pinch of orange zest or cinnamon if you like.⁠ ⁠ ⁠ ⁠ ⁠ www.elibrecher.co.uk⁠ .⁠ .⁠ #elibrechernutrition #guthealth #nutritionist #nutritionistlondon #digestivehealth #gut #guthealthy #gutmicrobiome #microbiome #gutbrainaxis #crohns #colitis #ibd #ibs #inflammation #probiotics #dairyfree #glutenfree #autoimmune #healthyrecipes #guthealthnutritionist

NUTRITION & SKIN 🥑
 
 ⁠🍳 Diet can play a key role when it comes to our skin, with the skin’s condition often reflecting what we eat. Many of us spend vast amounts of money on skincare products but it’s just as important to nourish your skin from the inside out.
 
 🍉 Beyond what we eat, our skin can be influenced by various other elements, such as premature ageing, including sun exposure, smoking and alcohol intake. High stress levels and genetic factors can also impact our skin. While some of these considerations of out of our control, we can take charge of our diet to ensure that our skin is getting all the nutrients it needs.
 
 🥦 A healthy balanced diet, rich in vitamins, minerals and antioxidants, as well as protein and healthy fats can have a positive impact on skin, contributing to the glowing complexion we all seek. 
 
 👉🏼 It’s important to note that there are no quick fixes, so eating one healthy meal isn’t going to change the health of your skin overnight – so consistency is key!

Your Ulcerative Colitis is created from infections and overgrowths inside your small intestines 💡  That can either be a: -parasitic infection 🪱  -fungal overgrowth 🍄  -bacterial overgrowth 🦠  -and/or a viral infection virus 🦠  It could even be a combination of those that has built up in your intestines and what’s knocking it out of balance 👎 When you’ve got these infections or overgrowths inside your body and you eat food 🥘  The food goes down to your small intestines and it ferments and give off a gas 💨  So it’s very likely that you’ve got bloating or flatulence, or acid reflux, or burping 🌬️  These overgrowths also eat the nutrients from your food and dump stuff like isopropyl alcohol, lactic acid, and phenol into your body 😳 All this creates inflammation in your intestinal lining, which allows food particles into your blood where they create further inflammation🤯 Your body then create antibodies to that  food that got into your blood which creates negative reactions to that food when you eat it again 😩 The way I fixed my UC was by removing these infections, healing my intestinal lining whilst cleansing my body ✅   If you want to know more DM me the word HELP…And I’ll be happy to help you out 💜 . . . . . . . #crohns #colitis #ibd #ibs #crohnsdisease #crohnsandcolitis #crohnsandcolitisuk #ulcerativecolitis #guthealth #gut #guthealth #qenda #bloating #sibo #mouldinfection #autoimmune #digestiveexpert #leakygut #anxiety #depression #mentalhealth #constipation #microbiome #leakygut #probiotic #foodintolerance #psoriasis #eczema #naturalremedy

Today is also World IDB Day, a day where we can shine a light on Crohn’s and Colitis, the two main forms of Inflammatory Bowel Disease. As a gut health nutritionist, I have had the opportunity to talk with individuals who suffer from Crohn’s and Colitis, providing support in managing their symptoms. This experience has given me a glimpse into the challenges they face, including not only the physical symptoms associated with these conditions but also the impact it has on work life, relationships, finances, vacations and exercise.  That’s why I’ve decided to raise money for @crohnsandcolitisuk , a fantastic charity that’s all about raising awareness and understanding of these conditions and providing support to those affected. Together, we can make sure that early detection and timely medical attention become a priority. We need to start talking openly about Crohn’s and Colitis, breaking the silence and letting those who are suffering know that they’re not alone. I’m super excited that I’ll be running the Royal Parks Half Marathon on behalf of Crohn’s and Colitis. As I train for this challenge, I’ll be sharing valuable information about these conditions, helping you understand their symptoms and raising awareness for early diagnosis. I’d love for you to join me on this journey, whether it’s by donating, spreading awareness, or sharing this information!  #crohns #colitis #crohnsandcolitis #ibd #ibdawareness #worldibdday

Today is #WorldIBDDay and we’re back with the final video in our #PoowithPride campaign. #PoowithPride is aimed at trying to overcome the stigma surrounding poo, something that we still hear is a regular and important issue for our community of supporters. The couple in this video don’t have Inflammatory Bowel Disease. But more than 500,000 people in the UK do. If you’ve got Crohn’s or Colitis, you’ll know the list of symptoms is long, and includes having to poo urgently and often. Just because you have food intolerance; doesn’t mean you have to cut that food out for the rest of your life ✅ The reason for that is food intolerance is different to an allergy 💡  An allergy is something you were born with so it is a lot harder to reverse 🤓 Food intolerance is something that comes on overtime ⏳  The reason why you get food intolerance is because you have inflammation in your intestinal lining 👎 Which is gaps between your intestinal cells that allow undigested food particles to pass through into your blood 😳 Then your immune system thinks these undigested food particles are an intruder trying to attack the body 🧨 So your immune system goes on high alert And creates inflammation and antibodies to that specific food 🥘  (Those antibodies are your body’s defence to that food) 🏰  So the food passing through your inflamed intestinal lining creates that whole inflammatory response to food in your body 🚨 Yes, it’s great to cut out that food in the short term, but… The good news is🌞 You don’t have to cut it out everyday for the rest of your life 🙏 If you want to know more, DM me the word HELP...And I'lI be happy to help you out 💜 . . . . . . . #crohns #colitis #ibd #ibs #probiotics #kefir #crohnsandcolitisuk #ulcerativecolitis  #gut #guthealth #qenda #bloating #sibo #foodintolerance #autoimmune #digestiveexpert #leakygut #anxiety #depression #mentalhealth #constipation #microbiome  #probiotic #foodintolerance #psoriasis #eczema #naturalremedy

Before you buy any supplement you need to make sure that it has been 3rd party tested 🔎  Third party testing is test carried out by a company other than the one selling or manufacturing it 🤝 This testing ideally will confirm that the product is free from impurities such as:  -metals ⚓️ -moulds 🍄  -plastics 🧃 -and pesticide residues ☠️  Even if something’s certified or organic, that doesnt mean its free from or has been tested for all these impurities (toxins) 🤯 These impurities accumulate in your body 📈 They can feed the parasites and even have negative effects in your body even if you don't have parasites 😳 If you're shopping for supplements, always check that it has been third party tested to be free from these impurities so you know exactly what you're getting ✅ If you want to know what supplements I recommend for autoimmune, digestive, and skin issues ✨ DM me the word HELP…And I’ll be happy to help you out 💜 . . . . . . . #crohns #colitis #ibd #ibs #crohnsdisease #crohnsandcolitis #crohnsandcolitisuk #ulcerativecolitis #guthealth #gut #guthealth #qenda #bloating #sibo #mouldinfection #autoimmune #digestiveexpert #leakygut #anxiety #depression #mentalhealth #constipation #microbiome #leakygut #probiotic #foodintolerance #psoriasis #eczema #naturalremedy

Have you got food intolerances? 🤷‍♂️ Then you’ve cut out that food and felt better for a while, but then ended up getting more food intolerances to the foods you replaced it with!? 😩 That’s exactly what I did when I was 21 when I was diagnosed with Ulcerative Colitis and Crohn’s Disease 🙃 At that time, I only cut out only gluten, onions, and broccoli 🥦  And by the age of 25, I ended up intolerant to everything I ate! 😳 And everything I ate went through me in 10-15mins and came out undigested 😱 But the good news is don’t have those food intolerances now 🥳 To reverse a food intolerance, just cutting out the specific food doesn’t deal with the root cause👎 The root cause is usually inflammation in your intestinal lining, let him through the undigested foods into your blood🧐 Then your immune system responds by creating antibodies to that food🦠 So your food intolerances are caused by infections and overgrowths – creating inflammation in your intestinal lining💡 We need to get rid of these infections and overgrowths and get your microbiome back into balance ⚖️  To help remove this inflammation in your intestinal lining ✅ When you do that, you’ll find you’re no longer sensitive to food💪🏻 If you want to know more, DM me the word HELP...And I'lI be happy to help you out 💜 . . . . . . . #crohns #colitis #ibd #ibs #probiotics #kefir #crohnsandcolitisuk #ulcerativecolitis  #gut #guthealth #qenda #bloating #sibo #foodintolerance #autoimmune #digestiveexpert #leakygut #anxiety #depression #mentalhealth #constipation #microbiome  #probiotic #foodintolerance #psoriasis #eczema #naturalremedy

Are you getting loose stools? 😫 If so, it's also very likely that you are also getting brain fog, low energy fatigue and some reactions to certain foods 🥛  That’s a telltale sign that you have an infection in your small intestine 💡  When your food goes down into your small intestine it will react unfavourably with the infection👎 The infection will specify be a: -bacterial overgrowth🦠  -parasitic infection 🪱  -fungal overgrowth 🍄  -or even a viral infection 👾 That’s knocking your digestion out of balance ❌ Any of these things can actually create diarrhea further down 😳 And the good news about that is, we can fix it 👌 We need to remove the infections and overgrowths out of your small intestine✅ So when your food goes into your small intestine, it is digested and broken down correctly 👍 And you no longer have the issues showing as loose stools and diarrhea💪🏻 So you can feel better 🙏 Just give me a DM and I’ll be happy to help💚 DM me to find out more 💚 . . . . . . . #crohns #colonicmassage #colitis #ibd #ibs #crohnsdisease #crohnsandcolitis #crohnsandcolitisuk #ulcerativecolitis #guthealth #gut #guthealth #qenda #knowledgeispower #bloating #sibo #mouldinfection #toenailfungus #autoimmune #digestiveexpert #leakygut #anxiety #depression #mentalhealth #constipation #microbiome #leakygut #probiotic #foodintolerance #psoriasis #cream #eczema #naturalremedy

Did you know that eating a sweet potato can knock you three times over the drink driving limit 🤯 If you get brain fog and feel wavey in the afternoons you need to know about Small intestinal bacterial overgrowth or SIBO… SIBO is when you have too many bad bugs in your intestines and they’ve outnumbered your good bugs Then when you eat carbohydrates...🥔  they actually ferment with the bad bacterias and yeasts and rapidly create ethanol (alcohol)🍷  This fermentation inside you can knock your blood levels 3x over the drink drive limit 🚗  So if you feel crap and you’re suffering with brain fog, fatigue and walking around bloated feeling drunk… That is because you literally are drunk! 🥴  It’s because of bacterial and yeast overgrowths🦠  Bloating is not normal 🤰 Brain fog is not normal 🧠  You can fix it! 🙌 When you remove these overgrowths from your body and heal your intestines you no longer suffer with the brain fog the drunk feeling👍 You can have high energy 💪🏻 You can have clarity 💡  That’s what it’s all about, you enjoying life and feeling fantastic 🌟  . . . . . . . #cro#crohnsl#colonicmassagel#colitisd#ibds#ibso#crohnsdiseaseo#crohnsandcolitiso#crohnsandcolitisukc#ulcerativecolitist#guthealtht#gutt#guthealthn#qendao#knowledgeispowero#bloatingb#sibou#mouldinfectione#toenailfungust#autoimmuneg#digestiveexperta#leakygutx#anxietyp#depressionn#mentalhealthn#constipationc#microbiomea#leakyguto#probiotico#foodintoleranceo#psoriasise#creamz#eczematuralremedy

If you're suffering from abdominal pain 😖 It's very likely that you've got infection or overgrowth ☠️ Creating that abdominal pain inside your body ‼️ Symptoms of infection or overgrowth can be: - bloating 🫄 - flatulence 💨 - burping 🫧 - diarrhea 💩 - constipation 😣 And if you have any of these You know you've got infection or overgrowth inside your body ☠️ I speak to hundreds of people every month 📅 And a lot of them have underlying abdominal pain 😖 And they can't get to the "bottom" of it 🍑  Your digestive system goes: esophagus - stomach - small intestines - large intestine ✅ So your intestines are nearly 30 foot in length 📏 And if you got inflammation in there, that's why you can have abdominal pain ✅ If you want to know more, DM me the word HELP...And I'lI be happy to help you out 💜 . . . . . . . #crohns #colitis #ibd #ibs #probiotics #mucus #crohnsandcolitisuk #ulcerativecolitis  #gut #guthealth #qenda #bloating #sibo #foodintolerance #autoimmune #digestiveexpert #leakygut #anxiety #depression #mentalhealth #constipation #microbiome  #probiotic #foodintolerance #psoriasis #eczema #naturalremedy

Boiling tap water does not make it cleaner! 🚰  So many people in the UK won’t drink fresh tap water but they don't mind drinking it if it has been boiled in a kettle 🤷‍♂️ When you boil tap water, the steam that comes out the spout is a 100% pure water 💧  But the water that’s left in the kettle of boiled tap water is just heated up recycled toilet water 🚽  This, is my opinion, is not ideal conditions for good health 👎 It can have oestrogen mimicking hormones in from “the pill” 💊  It can have feaces 💩  it has chlorine added to it to kill of the bacterias ☠️ So just boiling it  in a kettle does not make it clean 🧼  If you want to have clean water in your cups of tea, I recommend getting reverse osmosis filter with remineralization 👌 You can have those under your sink or on the counter top✅ I personally recommend to every customer and client that they do this 🙏 . . . . . . . #crohns #colonicmassage #colitis #ibd #ibs #crohnsdisease #crohnsandcolitis #crohnsandcolitisuk #ulcerativecolitis #guthealth #gut #guthealth #qenda #knowledgeispower #bloating #sibo #mouldinfection #toenailfungus #autoimmune #digestiveexpert #leakygut #anxiety #depression #mentalhealth #constipation #microbiome #leakygut #probiotic #foodintolerance #tapwater #waterfilter

What causes your IBS? & How to fix it in 60 seconds ⏳  IBS is caused by an infection or an imbalance in your small intestine  … Then when the carbohydrates you eat go into your small intestine and ferment with these overgrowths and imbalances 😳 This creates inflammation, gas and bloating 💨  When you have these imbalances in your small intestine, it creates inflammation inside the intestinal lining 🔥  Instead of your intestinal cells being tight junctions together, you get gaps between them 🕳️ When your undigested food passes through these gaps in your inflamed intestines, it goes straight into your blood 🩸  Then your immune system perceives the undigested food as an intruder and then makes antibodies against that food 👾 You then have a food intolerance👎 When you consume that food again, you end up with a reaction and more inflammation😫 So then you end up with diarrhoea and/or constipation 🌧️  Also, this immune response and inflammation in the blood can end up making you have lethargy, low mood and brain fog 🫠 The way to fix all these IBS symptoms is to remove the infections and imbalances from your small intestines ✅ DM me and I’ll be happy to explain more 💚 . . . . . . . #crohns #colonicmassage #colitis #ibd #ibs #crohnsdisease #crohnsandcolitis #crohnsandcolitisuk #ulcerativecolitis #guthealth #gut #guthealth #qenda #knowledgeispower #bloating #sibo #mouldinfection #toenailfungus #autoimmune #digestiveexpert #leakygut #anxiety #depression #mentalhealth #constipation #microbiome #leakygut #probiotic #foodintolerance

Boiling tap water does not make it cleaner! 🚰  So many people in the UK won’t drink fresh tap water but they don't mind drinking it if it has been boiled in a kettle 🤷‍♂️ When you boil tap water, the steam that comes out the spout is a 100% pure water 💧  But the water that’s left in the kettle of boiled tap water is just heated up recycled toilet water 🚽  This, is my opinion, is not ideal conditions for good health 👎 It can have oestrogen mimicking hormones in from “the pill” 💊  It can have feaces 💩  it has chlorine added to it to kill of the bacterias ☠️ So just boiling it  in a kettle does not make it clean 🧼  If you want to have clean water in your cups of tea, I recommend getting reverse osmosis filter with remineralization 👌 You can have those under your sink or on the counter top✅ I personally recommend to every customer and client that they do this 🙏 . . . . . . . #crohns #colonicmassage #colitis #ibd #ibs #crohnsdisease #crohnsandcolitis #crohnsandcolitisuk #ulcerativecolitis #guthealth #gut #guthealth #qenda #knowledgeispower #bloating #sibo #mouldinfection #toenailfungus #autoimmune #digestiveexpert #leakygut #anxiety #depression #mentalhealth #constipation #microbiome #leakygut #probiotic #foodintolerance #tapwater #waterfilter

Are probiotic supplements necessary for everyone’s gut health? 🦠  Probiotic supplements can be beneficial, particularly to some people who suffer with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), UTIs and various gastrointestinal issues.  ⚠️ However, probiotic supplements are not necessary for everyone.  ⛔️ Probiotics should be completely avoided by certain groups of people including anyone who is severely immunocompromised (has a weakened immune system) or who has open wounds following major surgery, as well as those with pancreatitis.  👉🏼 One issue is that there are so many different types of probiotics available, with varying strains of bacteria and all kinds of confusing terminology like CFUs (Colony Forming Unit used to measure the amount of a particular bacteria), so it can be hard to know which one is right for you, and which ones probably won’t make any difference.

Are probiotic supplements necessary for everyone’s gut health? 🦠  Probiotic supplements can be beneficial, particularly to some people who suffer with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), UTIs and various gastrointestinal issues.  ⚠️ However, probiotic supplements are not necessary for everyone.  ⛔️ Probiotics should be completely avoided by certain groups of people including anyone who is severely immunocompromised (has a weakened immune system) or who has open wounds following major surgery, as well as those with pancreatitis.  👉🏼 One issue is that there are so many different types of probiotics available, with varying strains of bacteria and all kinds of confusing terminology like CFUs (Colony Forming Unit used to measure the amount of a particular bacteria), so it can be hard to know which one is right for you, and which ones probably won’t make any difference.

Ulcerative Colitis: Something I dont talk about because I find it embarassing still.  I was diagnosed with Ulcerative Colitis in 2020 but I have suffered since I was a child. Ive had nasty comments made to me when I have used disabled toilets many a time and it is not ok. Not every disability is visible.  Why an I embarrassed? Because everyone thinks its all about poo!  Well yes that is an element in this disease but its not the only symptom.  I manage my symptoms with preventitive medication ever day but nothing can guarantee not having a flare up. Ive lived with embarassment of having to leave events becausethe pain gets so intense that i have to be in the toilet the whole night, ive felt ashamed because ive been at a boys house and flared up and spent all night in his bathroom.  Its not a laughing matter and i need to stop feeling like this.  Im not a the severity of needing a colostomy bag but i live in fear that one day this could be my outcome.  Just wanted to raise some awareness and try and help myself become more confident in who I am🫶#fyp #viral #colitis #crohnsdisease #ibdawareness #boweldisease #notalldisabilitiesarevisible #bekind #invisibleillness

If you’re having negative reactions to eating foods 🍔 And you think you have food intolerances 🚨 The cheapest and most effective thing you can do is the elimination diet 👌 When you’re doing an elimination diet you need to totally cut out that food ✂️ Two common food allergens that I recommend cutting out straight away are: 1- gluten 🥖 2- dairy 🥛  When you cut these out, you need to make sure that you are not having ANY gluten or dairy in your diet whatsoever ✅ Then when you keep a food diary you will get clear results 📔 Use the food diary too, track your symptoms over the next three days after, either: -eating the food 🍲   or  -cutting that food out ❌ When you find you are intolerant to that food 🍱  You need to totally cut that food out for 3-6 months until the antibodies have left your body 👾 Whilst also reversing the damage to the intestinal lining that is making you react to foods in the first place✅ If you do have food intolerances and reacting to foods 😖 And you want some help fixing that, DM me the word HELP...And I'lI be happy to help you out 💜 . . . . . . . #crohns #colitis #ibd #ibs #probiotics #mucus #crohnsandcolitisuk #ulcerativecolitis  #gut #guthealth #qenda #bloating #sibo #foodintolerance #autoimmune #digestiveexpert #leakygut #anxiety #depression #mentalhealth #constipation #microbiome  #probiotic #foodintolerance #psoriasis #eczema #naturalremedy

"What aggravates Ankylosing Spondylitis?"  A question from Tiktok (surprisingly as I have no idea how that app works 😆) Here are 5 things that can (or might) make symptoms worse 👇👇👇 🧵 2. Highly processed diet / excess abdominal fat These increase your bodies general level of inflammation and this is what is causing the symptoms of AS Simply more inflammation = Worse AS 3. Being Sedentary In AS activity almost always makes symptoms better immediately and in the long term Both general activity levels e.g. the number of steps in a day and also intentionally exercising are very beneficial factors 4. Getting Sick As a double punishment getting sick requires your immune system to increase its activity a lot and this will often significantly increase the symptoms of AS 5. SEX (no not that 😉) Being Male tends to mean more structural changes in the spine Being Female tends to mean more widespread pain and joint / tendon pains in the arms and the legs Want to ask a question or learn more? "What is Seronegative Arthritis?" A Question from Instagram, so let's check it out. "Seronegative Arthritis" is a type of arthritis that is characterized by a negative test for rheumatoid factor, a protein found in the blood of people with rheumatoid arthritis. There are several different types of seronegative arthritis, including ankylosing spondylitis, psoriatic arthritis, reactive arthritis, and enteropathic arthritis. Rheumatoid Arthritis can also be "seronegative" in which the Rheumatoid Factor is not raised despite the diagnosis. "What is Primary Raynaud's?" Lets take a look!  Primary Raynaud's, also known as Raynaud's disease or phenomenon, is a condition that affects blood flow to the fingers, toes, and sometimes other areas of the body. It is caused by spasms of the small blood vessels that supply blood to the extremities. When the blood vessels narrow, blood flow is reduced, causing the affected areas to turn white, blue, or red, and feel cold and numb. Primary Raynaud's is a diagnosis of exclusion, meaning that other conditions, such as autoimmune disorders or vascular diseases, should be ruled out before it can be confidently diagnosed There is no known cure for Primary Raynaud's, but there are treatments that can help manage symptoms. Lifestyle changes, such as avoiding cold temperatures and wearing warm clothing, can be effective. Vasodilators may help as well. We should be aware of Primary Raynaud's and its potential impact on patients. Patients may experience pain, discomfort, and reduced function in their hands and feet, which can affect their quality of life. Want to ask a question or learn more? "What is a CRP blood test?" C-reactive protein (CRP) is a test that measures the level of inflammation in the body. Read on for more The test is usually ordered by healthcare professionals as part of a routine check-up or when a patient presents with symptoms of infection or inflammation. High CRP levels can be an indicator of conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis, lupus, or an infection. It can also be a marker for cardiovascular disease. CRP levels can be influenced by factors such as infection, injury, surgery, and certain medications, so it's important to interpret the results in context with the patient's overall clinical picture. CRP levels alone do not diagnose a specific condition, it is usually used in conjunction with other lab tests and clinical examination. #CRP #bloodtest #inflammation Normal - <5 Raised - 5+ High - 50+ Want to ask a question or learn more? Osteoarthritis (OA) is the most common form of arthritis. It is charecterised by pain, stiffness, and swelling in the joints. Most commonly the hips and knees but many other joints as well. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), OA is one of the top 10 most disabling diseases in developed countries.  It's estimated that 10% of men and 18% of women over the age of 60 have OA. Many many more will have radiological changes associated with Osteoarthritis.  Certain risk factors can increase your chances of developing OA, such as obesity (particularly abdominal circumference), joint injuries, genetics and surgery. Women are also more likely to develop OA than men. Running DOES NOT appear associated with developing Osteoarthritis. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36809693/ Want to ask a question or learn more? "Tell the difference between Rheumatoid Arthritis and Osteoarthritis in the hand" Possibly THE MOST common question I get from all angles... Normally I palm it off BUT NOT THIS TIME... 👇👇👇 LOCATION Rheumatoid Arthritis: MCPJs (knuckles) and wrists Osteoarthritis: CMCJ (thumb base) and DIPJs (end finger joints) NUMBER OF JOINTS Rheumatoid Arthritis: 4+ joints affected (including elsewhere in the body) Osteoarthritis: 1-4 joints affected  SWELLING Rheumatoid Arthritis: Typically swollen with redness and hot Osteoarthritis: Typically not swollen, red or hot. If there are these symptoms they are lower grade STIFFNESS Rheumatoid Arthritis: Significant joint stiffness lasting 60+ mins in the morning and after inactivity Osteoarthritis: Joint stiffness for 5-15 mins in the morning and after inactivity  Want to ask a question or learn more? "Who Gets Arthritis?" Arthritis is a common condition affecting joints, but who does it affect? Let's break it down. 💡 #ArthritisFacts Age is a significant factor. While arthritis can begin at any age, it's more common as we get older. Osteoarthritis is less common before the age of 40 Axial Spondyloarthritis is less common after 40 Rheumatoid Arthritis peak middles 30-60 Genetics also play a role.  If you have a family history of arthritis, your risk increases. Certain genes predispose individuals to different types of arthritis. People who are overweight (particularly abdominal fat), lead a sedentary lifestyle or smoke have a higher risk.  On the flip side, staying active and maintaining a healthy weight or losing weight can help reduce the risk. Sex! (No, not that) Being Female predisposes an increased risk of developing almost all types of Arthritis by a ratio of approximately 3:1 Joint injury  Injuries to joints (especially the knee) elevate the risk of developing Osteoarthritis This is not mitigated by surgical repair. It might even increase the risk to other joints even if they were uninjured. Want to ask a question or learn more? 🄿🄰🄽🄲🄰🄺🄸🄽🄶: Pancaking occurs when a vacuum (absence of air) occurs in the stoma bag, preventing the soma output dropping down into the bag. This can happen with a colostomy or ileostomy. The main reason for pancaking is due to the filter on the bag letting all the air out so there is none left in the bag.  To reduce it from happening you can: ⚡️Blow air in to the bag ⚡️Trap air in the bag by adding a cotton wool ball/tissue ⚡️Regularly open your bag  ⚡️Add a lubricant to the inside of the bag to enable waste to top down easily #pancaking #pancake #stoma #stomaaware #stomalife #ostomy #ostomatelife #ostomyblogger #ostomyawareness #ostomylife #learn #ostomate #nocolonstillrollin #notalldisabilitiesarevisible #crohns #colitis #uc #ulcerativecolitis #ibd #inflammatoryboweldisease #coloplast #toptips #everydaysaschoolday@Coloplast @Coloplast_UK @Crohn’s & Colitis UK @#IBDSuperHeroes

Your arthritis is created from infections inside your intestines 🦠 What I find is - when people suffer with arthritis, they also have other underlying digestive issues 😫 These can be: -constipation 💩 -loose stools 💩 -bloating 🏀 -flatulence 💨 -stomach cramps 😱 -food intolerances 🥗 These are all signs that you have an infection in your intestines, which is directly creating your arthritis ✅ When you have infections in your intestines, it creates inflammation in there to try get the infections moving along 🚨 The issue is - what inflammation is in your intestinal lining is gaps in your intestinal cells 😱 Undigested food particles and other wastes & toxins pass through into your blood 🩸 Once in the blood, your immune system perceives this undigested food particles and other wastes & toxins as intruders ⚠️ So, it creates inflammation inside your blood to deal with them 😫 Then, you have inflamed blood supplying all your body - that’s why you can have inflammation showing all over your body, specifically your joints 🖖 If you want to know more, DM me the word HELP and I’ll be happy to help you out 💚 . . . . . . . #hepatitis #colitis #ibd #ibs #crohnsdisease #crohnsandcolitis #crohnsandcolitisuk #ulcerativecolitis #guthealth #gut #guthealth #qenda #bloating #sibo #mouldinfection #autoimmune #digestiveexpert #leakygut #anxiety #depression #mentalhealth #constipation #microbiome #leakygut #probiotic #foodintolerance #psoriasis #eczema #naturalremedy

"What Are Bouchard Nodes?" Read on for more  Bouchard nodes are small, bony growths that occur in the fingers and hands of individuals with #osteoarthritis  They form in response to the inflammatory process and degradation of the cartilage.  They could be considered part of an attempted protective mechanism. Bouchard nodes can cause pain and discomfort, making it difficult to perform daily activities. This is especially true to compression or impact. Want to ask a question or learn more? If you’re seeing undigested meat in your stools, that means, you haven’t chewed it properly 🥩 If you’re getting big lumps of meat, that means you must have swallowed big lumps of meat for it to go through your digestive system and come out the other side 🚨 What I’ve seen with so many people is that they just inhale the meat 🌬 It’s like they are in a race - trying to eat the steak as fast as possible 🏇 When you’re chewing any food, you want to che it up 20-30 times, so it becomes a fine mush in your mouth ✅ There’s two reasons for that: 1 - Your stomach doesn’t have teeth 🦷 So, the chewing that you do in your mouth, is the only chewing that’s ever gonna get done in this whole process ✅ 2 - The more you chew, especially with your face at eye level, it sends signals to your pancreas to release the digestive enzymes in your stomach; which further helps breakdown the protein in your stomach and small intestine ✅ So, yes! Red meat is good for you. You just have to make sure that you chew it properly 🥩 So, you can get all the health benefits from it 🤩 If you want to know more, DM me the word HELP and I’ll be happy to help you out 💚 . . . . . . . #hepatitis #colitis #ibd #ibs #crohnsdisease #crohnsandcolitis #crohnsandcolitisuk #ulcerativecolitis #guthealth #gut #guthealth #qenda #bloating #sibo #mouldinfection #autoimmune #digestiveexpert #leakygut #anxiety #depression #mentalhealth #constipation #microbiome #leakygut #probiotic #foodintolerance #psoriasis #eczema #naturalremedy

Three-step protocol to get rid of toenail fungus 🍄 Anything going on in your skin is a window of what’s going on in your body ✅ So, if you have toenail fungus, it shows you have fungal infection inside your body 🚨 Step 1:  We need to make sure you have no moulds or fungus in your living environment 🏠 If you have a bathroom or bedroom that has damp or mould, you want to make sure that you get that sorted out 👍 Otherwise, you’re always gonna breathe in these mould spores and get reinfected 🚨 Step 2:  I recommend 4 months of Qenda Ultimate Fibre ✅ This is the basic protocol that I get all my clients on 🤩 It’s a blend of herbs, specifically formulated for optimal gut health 🍃 Step 3:  Go onto a specific carbohydrate diet ✅ This diet cuts out all all simple sugars, which are fermentable carbohydrates✂️ The mould infection can reside in the upper part of the small intestines 😫 So, when you consume these simple sugars, they breakdown very early in the digestive system and feed the fungal infection 🍄 Which is why you’re getting the symptoms like: -gas -bloating -flatulence By cutting out simple sugars, you’re no longer feeding the mould infections and the previuos two steps can work bring your body back into balance ⚖️ If you want to know more, DM me the word HELP and I’ll be happy to help you out 💚 . . . . . . . #hepatitis #colitis #ibd #ibs #crohnsdisease #crohnsandcolitis #crohnsandcolitisuk #ulcerativecolitis #guthealth #gut #guthealth #qenda #bloating #sibo #mouldinfection #autoimmune #digestiveexpert #leakygut #anxiety #depression #mentalhealth #constipation #microbiome #leakygut #probiotic #foodintolerance #psoriasis #eczema #naturalremedy

The reason why you’re having foul smelling farts & poos is because of an imbalance inside digestive system ⚖️ What I found is - people with smelly farts & poos have always got infections & overgrowths inside the body 🦠 That infection and overgrowths are eating nutrients from your food 😱 And they dump into your body: -isopropyl alcohol 😫 -lactic acid 🚨 -phenol ☢️ -formaldehyde ⛔️ And these make your body very acidic ⚠️ Even if you put healthy food in, it can smell very unhealthy when it comes out 😱 That’s because it’s not just your body digesting your food, you’re also feeding other organisms inside your body 🦠 So, to resolve this, we need to get rid of the infections ✅ It can be: -fungal infection 🍄 -parasite infection 🐛 -bacterial overgrowth 🦠 -viral infection 👾 And these can all knock the body out of balance and create smelly farts and poos 💩 So, we need to get rid of these infections so your digestive system can work just as it did before you started getting the symptoms ✅ If you want to know more, DM me the word HELP and I’ll be happy to help you out 💚 . . . . . . . #hepatitis #colitis #ibd #ibs #crohnsdisease #crohnsandcolitis #crohnsandcolitisuk #ulcerativecolitis #guthealth #gut #guthealth #qenda #bloating #sibo #mouldinfection #autoimmune #digestiveexpert #leakygut #anxiety #depression #mentalhealth #constipation #microbiome #leakygut #probiotic #foodintolerance #psoriasis #eczema #naturalremedy

Your low energy, brain fog, fatigue is all related to imbalances inside your digestive system 🚨 What I found is all the clients that I’ve helped with anxiety, depression, low mood, fatigue, they all have an underlying infection inside their digestive issue - creating these symptoms 😱 It is always the following that’s creating the issues: -fungal infection 🍄 -bacterial overgrowth🦠 -parasite infection 🐛 -viral infection 👾 When you got infections in your small intestines, your body creates inflammation in that intestinal lining to try and move these infections along 😫 The problem is - once you got inflammation in your intestinal lining, that means you have gaps in your intestinal lining 🚨 So then, undigested food particles and other wastes and toxins can pass through these gaps and into your blood 🩸 When this happens, your immune system can perceive these undigested food particles and other wastes and toxins as intruders - it thinks it’s a virus trying to attack the body 🚨 So, you have inflamed blood circulating around your body including your brain and it creates inflammation in your brain 🧠 And the clinical definition of depression is an inflamed brain ✅ What we need to do is get rid of these infections, remove the inflammation from the intestinal lining, and get your body back into balance ⚖️ If you want to know more, DM me the word HELP and I’ll be happy to help you out 💚 . . . . . . . #hepatitis #colitis #ibd #ibs #crohnsdisease #crohnsandcolitis #crohnsandcolitisuk #ulcerativecolitis #guthealth #gut #guthealth #qenda #bloating #sibo #mouldinfection #autoimmune #digestiveexpert #leakygut #anxiety #depression #mentalhealth #constipation #microbiome #leakygut #probiotic #foodintolerance #psoriasis #eczema #naturalremedy

Once they get infections and overgrowths inside their small intestines - this knocks their digestive system out of balance and create symptoms all over the body 🚨 So, if you’re suffering from Hashimoto’s, and you got symptoms like bloating, gas, flatulence, constipation, and loose stools -  that shows that you got an infection in your digestive system, creating all the other issues 😫 These infections can be: -parasite infection 🐛 -fungal overgrowth 🍄 -bacterial overgrowth 🦠 -viral infection 👾 Then, your immune system recognizes that and creates inflammation inside your intestinal lining to try deal with infections 😫 Then, you get undigested food particles and other wastes and toxins pass through into your blood 🩸 And your immune system creates antibodies to those undigested food particles and other wastes and toxins 🚨 Now, you have antibodies in your blood circulating around your body. Winter warming vegan miso soup This recipe is so quick and easy to 6 it is packed with so many plant points, versatile, easy, and so tasty … Give it a go, and if you want to make it meaty, feel free to add chicken or eggs too.  INGREDIENTS: Approx 2 litres of water  Vegetables add any that you want : Mushrooms (use a variety of different ones as they are great for immunity) I used a punnet of mixed mushrooms  1-2 garlic cloves (grated) use this to taste Ginger (a thumb size piece) grated A tin of water chestnuts (well rinsed and drained) A bunch of chopped coriander 1 small red or green chilli (if you want to make it spicy) Spring onions  1 carrot 1/2 red onion  1 teaspoon of turmeric powder (helps reduce inflammation) A few florets of broccoli  Add if cauliflower if you like it Sugar snap peas Baby sweet corn  A tablespoon of miso paste 1 tablespoon of apple cider vinegar 1 table spoon of toasted sesame seed oil 4 -6 oz of tofu (chopped into squares) Salt to taste if you need it.  METHOD: Bring water to the boil Add the miso, garlic and ginger and boil for five minutes Add the rest of the ingredients  except for the coriander and spring onions Bring it all to the boil and garnish with the corriander and spring onions (for crunch and flavour) just as you serve it. Optional This recipe is so versatile…add some eggs or chicken for extra protein  Add pepper if you like it and also any vegetables you like and have in your fridge. Looking at your bowel movements after you’ve been to the toilet can tell you so much about the health of your body ✅ Check your stools shape and texture tells us a lot👁️  Then if you’re having 3 meals a day, you want to be having a similar amount of (2-4) healthy bowel movements a day 🍽️ 🟰 💩  So what does a healthy bowel movement look like? 🤷‍♂️ A moist solid formed sausage without undigested foods inside it; that’s the ideal 👌 If looser tending towards the side of diarrhoea where it’s looser and not a defined shape 🥖 That shows us that you’ve got some sort of infection 🦠  Whenever you get a bug, we get sickness or diarrhoea - that’s the body’s way of flushing it out 🚽  That means if you are getting diarrhoea a lot of the time, that shows that there’s a persistent infection that your body just cannot get rid of 🪱  If it’s more like constipation, it will be either like pellets or dried, and cracked stool 🫘 This constipation can either be dehydration or it can be an imbalance in the intestines 📊 (If it’s dehydration, your urine will dark yellow or light brown) 🍺  If you're not having nice healthy moist sausage-shaped stools or you’re not having 2-4 bowel movements a day 📉 Feel free to DM me the word HELP and I’ll be happy to help you out and explain more💚 . . . . . . . #crohns #colonicmassage #colitis #ibd #ibs #crohnsdisease #crohnsandcolitis #crohnsandcolitisuk #ulcerativecolitis #guthealth #gut #guthealth #qenda #knowledgeispower #bloating #sibo #mouldinfection #toenailfungus #autoimmune #digestiveexpert #leakygut #anxiety #depression #mentalhealth #constipation #microbiome #leakygut #probiotic #foodintolerance
